title: CDCLocator working guidance

R/address_place.R, R/address_point.R: cdc_address_place() cdc_address_point(), translate city state latitude longitude ZIP code. R/enums.R: valid services values validator. text: CDCLocator finds HIV testing, prevention, care related service providers near US ZIP code, using HIV.gov Locator API. returns results tibbles can filter, map join data. can: search providers within 1 50 miles ZIP code, 14 kinds service, HIV testing, PrEP, Ryan White care housing help; turn nested provider records one row per provider, name, address, phone, website, languages, coordinates distance; look ZIP code city state, latitude longitude. CDCLocator affiliated endorsed HIV.gov. early development, API’s behavior described observed November 2026.

title: Find HIV Service Providers with the HIV.gov Locator API
text: Find every kind service within 5 miles ZIP code: cdc_providers() returns API’s records details nested. get one row per provider plain columns, pass cdc_providers_tidy(): Search particular services . names listed ?cdc_providers: Start place point instead ZIP code: return one-row tibble ZIP code, can pass cdc_providers().
code: library(CDCLocator)  providers <- cdc_providers("20176", radius = 5) tidy <- cdc_providers_tidy(providers) tidy[, c("name", "street", "city", "contact_telephone", "distance")] prep <- cdc_providers("20176", radius = 10, services = c("preptesting", "pep")) cdc_address_place("Peoria", "IL") cdc_address_point(40.69365, -89.58899)

title: Find CDC HIV-related service providers by ZIP code — cdc_providers
text: zipcode five-digit ZIP code string, "02110". number lose leading zeros, rejected. radius Search radius miles: whole number 1 50. default 10. services Character vector services search , matched case: "hivtesting", "stdtesting", "selftesting", "preptesting", "pep", "condom", "hepc", "doxypep", "mailintesting", "ryanwhite", "clinics", "substanceabuse", "mentalhealth" "housing". NULL, default, searches . three services take one request. client_id Optional CDC client ID override. client_token Optional CDC client token override.
